title: euthamia graminifolia var. hirtipes
intro: Euthamia graminifolia var. hirtipes, commonly known as hairy fringed goldenrod, is a plant species in the asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of hairy fringed goldenrod, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, may also contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
